complete_examples.text: Furthermore, the use of the SEM method can reduce the number of DOFs by approximately 20 % compared to the FEM.
Conclusion In this study, a train-track-tunnel-soil (TTTS) dynamic interaction model based on the SEM is established.
Additionally, this paper introduces a substructure coordination technique combining the FEM and SEM, based on the elimination method.

The model leverages the distinct vibration characteristics of the near- and far- field regions of TTTS system, employing different modelling approaches: the FEM, known for its superior shape adaptability and precise high-frequency dynamic response computation, is applied to the tunnel and near-field soil; the SEM, recognized for its rapid convergence and suitability for low-frequency dynamic response, is utilized for the far-field soil.
